metadata.name: VizDemo
metadata.description: The jui viz demo page, running inside an iframe. The page is the static folder that `jui viz export-demo` writes, served by this site from /tools/viz-demo/<jsonui-cli version>/. Its data is built into the page; it talks to no server and loads nothing from another origin.

notes: Propless. There is one demo and one place it is served from, so a `src` prop would only invite a second copy to drift from the first.
The iframe title is the string key `tools_viz_demo_frame_title`, resolved per language like the other chrome strings.
Leaf component. The iframe owns its own document.

components.description: Wrapper that sizes the iframe: full width, a 16:10 frame with a minimum height so the narrow layout of the demo still fits.

example.description: Zero-attribute usage inside a Layout JSON.

notes: Rendering contract: <iframe src="/tools/viz-demo/<version>/index.html" title=... loading="lazy"> inside the wrapper. The demo is a same-origin page, so no sandbox flags are needed for it to run, and it may not be given any that let it reach another origin.

Colour mode: the demo reads `data-theme` on its own root element and watches it. The component sets that attribute to the site's colour mode (ColorManager) on load and on every change. It sets an attribute only; no script is added to the demo.

Updating the demo: run `jui viz export-demo --out <an empty folder>` with the pinned jsonui-cli into jsonui-doc-web/public/tools/viz-demo/<version>/, point DEMO_SRC in VizDemo.tsx at it, and delete the previous folder. A new folder, not an overwrite: deploy uploads non-HTML files as immutable for a year, and the export keeps its file names. Do it on every pin bump that changes the export.
Nothing is injected into the demo: no analytics, no measurement, no extra script. The request from the jui viz side asks for exactly that.
